Roadster VM-01 
Ugears introduces an exquisitely elegant and impressively fast Roadster VM-01 sports car. The unique charisma of the model comes from both its outstanding technical characteristics and detailed, realistic retro design. The clever combination of plywood elements of different thicknesses—4 and 2 mm—ensures the motorcar’s body looks streamlined and refined. Open the hood to see the powerful V8 engine and watch the moving valves.
Your sports car offers three driving modes: Forward, Reverse, and Idle. The direction can be adjusted using the functional steering wheel. Front-wheel suspension enhances the model’s realism. Powered by a rubber band motor, the car covers up to four meters on a single winding. The winding key is styled as a spare wheel at the rear. This wooden sports car has plenty to ignite your imagination—we invite you to discover its features yourself. Take your friends and family on a nostalgic ride and enjoy the fun with the Ugears Roadster VM-01!

Roadster VM-01 features:

Powered by a rubber band motor
Travels up to 4 meters on a single winding
Realistic V8 engine with moving valves
3 transmission modes: Forward, Reverse, and Idle
Steering wheel adjusts driving direction
Front wheel suspension for added realism
Spare wheel-styled winding key


DIY wooden car features:

Iconic vintage design with sleek, streamlined body   
Laser-pre-cut wooden parts
Assembles without glue or special tools
